fact_ids: 1967:American physicist Theodore Maiman is given a patent for his ruby laser systems, the world's first laser.
1988:The first Fairtrade label, Max Havelaar, is launched in the Netherlands.
2022:Artemis Program: NASA launches Artemis 1 on the first flight of the Space Launch System, the start of the program's future missions to the moon.
2019:The first known case of COVID-19 is traced to a 55-year-old man who had visited a market in Wuhan, Hubei Province, China.
1985:The first comic of Calvin and Hobbes is published in ten newspapers.
1999:Shenzhou 1: The People's Republic of China launches its first Shenzhou spacecraft.
1998:The first space station module component, Zarya, for the International Space Station is launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan.
2019:Tesla launches the SUV Cybertruck. A gaffe occurs during the launch event when its "unbreakable" windows shatter during demonstration.
1989:NASA launches Space Shuttle Discovery on STS-33, a classified mission for the United States Department of Defense.
